verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an Issuing balance funded from an external bank account (via Dashboard or API), real-time authorization decisioning, and a claim of "full transaction visibility," which covers only the edges of the story. Nothing documents a ledger linking each authorization to its clearing, or settlement reporting and reconciliation. Missing for 10: real-time account/card balance views, an authorization-to-clearing transaction ledger, settlement reports that reconcile to the penny, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
